bibl.title: P.Lund I 4 + P. Carlsb. inv. 50 ricongiunti. Frammenti di commedia adespota (PCG VIII 1066 + 1124)
bibl.seg: Roberta Carlesimo, P.Lund I 4 + P. Carlsb. inv. 50 ricongiunti. Frammenti di commedia adespota (PCG VIII 1066 + 1124).
bibl.note: P. Lund I, 4 (= MP3 1655; LDAB 2627) contains lines from an unknown comedy, doubtfully attributed to Menander in the ed.pr.; P. Carlsberg 50 preserves verses from a comedy possibly by Menander or Apollodorus of Carystus. The two fragments belong to the same bookroll. Discusses this joint, together with a new reconstruction of the comedy scene preserved by P. Lund I, 4 and some new readings.
